description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, such as converting strings to camelCase or Title Case, used across a web application's user interface. It exports two functions: toCamelCaseName and toTitleCaseName, each handling string normalization and casing with specific rules and examples.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase format, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespaces. Returns the original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Transforms a string into Title Case suitable for display, handling delimiters, spaces, and special characters like apostrophes, and accented characters. Returns the original value if it is not a string.
